result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally scrollable content (category chips and 'Fastest near you' cards) is cut off at the right edge without clear scroll affordance, and the rightmost restaurant card's title is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving no clear visual cue that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient mask or scroll indicator on the right edge to signal that more categories are available via horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped at the right edge and its title is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis for card titles, and add a right-edge fade or peek affordance to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the last pizza card image, cutting it off abruptly at the screen edge with no bottom padding or scroll margin.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the tab bar height so the last card can be fully scrolled into view.
